sources.title: Joint Consistency: A Unified Test-Time Aggregation Framework via Energy ...
sources.snippet: JC provides a unified framework for test-time aggregation that subsumes existing voting and weighted aggregation methods as special cases. Our construction of the interaction matrix leverages LLM-as-a-judge comparisons, and admits a theoretical interpretation under answer-level homo-geneity assumptions.
